await (async(page)=>{const ctx=await page.context().browser().newContext({viewport:{width:1600,height:1100}});const p=await ctx.newPage();const errors=[],checks=[];let progress='startup';p.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));const assert=(v,m)=>{if(!v)throw new Error(m)};try{await p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:5187/?stress=0&audio=0&run=architecture-release-ui');await p.waitForFunction(()=>!!window.__terriStress&&document.querySelector('#buy-object').options.length>1);if(await p.locator('#close-help').isVisible())await p.locator('#close-help').click();await p.locator('#build-toggle').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.body.dataset.building==='true');await p.locator('#build-tool-walls').click();const setup=await p.evaluate(()=>{const s=window.__terriStress.sim;for(let y=4;y<7;y++)s.setWallEdge(0,18,y,1);s.flushCommands();const preview=s.windowEditPreview(0,18,4,7);s.fitWindow(0,18,4,7);s.flushCommands();return{preview,windows:Array.from(s.windowPlacements())};});assert(setup.preview.valid,'valid fixture');const pos=await p.evaluate(()=>{const c=document.querySelector('#stage'),r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),o=window.__terriStress.origin;return{x:r.left+(o.x+(17.6-5)*32)*r.width/c.width,y:r.top+(o.y+(17.6+5)*21)*r.height/c.height};});await p.mouse.click(pos.x,pos.y);await p.waitForFunction(()=>!document.querySelector('#window-choices').hidden);assert(await p.locator('[data-window-model]').count()===9,'nine models');for(let id=1;id<=9;id++){const b=p.locator('[data-window-model="'+id+'"]');await b.click();assert(await b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true','selected model'+id);}checks.push('all nine model buttons select their model');await p.locator('[data-window-model="7"]').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('[data-context-action="fit-window"]')?.disabled===true);await p.locator('[data-window-model="4"]').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('[data-context-action="fit-window"]')?.disabled===false);await p.locator('[data-context-action="fit-window"]').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>Array.from(window.__terriStress.sim.windowPlacements()).join(',')==='0,18,4,4');checks.push('cached Fit refreshes from no-change disabled to narrower replacement enabled and applies');await p.locator('#window-back').click();await p.locator('[data-context-action="doorway"]').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>window.__terriStress.sim.lastWallEditResult()?.state===2);const door=await p.evaluate(()=>window.__terriStress.sim.lastWallEditResult());assert(door.axis===0&&door.x===18&&door.y===5,'clicked middle segment');checks.push('Back retains clicked middle unit for Doorway');await p.evaluate(()=>{const s=window.__terriStress.sim;s.setWallEdge(0,18,5,1);s.flushCommands();s.fitWindow(0,18,4,7);s.setFloor(4,4,1);s.setFloor(5,4,2);s.setFloor(6,4,3);s.flushCommands();});progress='Save and Load';await p.locator('#options-toggle').click();await p.locator('#save-game').click();await p.waitForFunction(()=>document.querySelector('#save-status').textContent.trim()==='Game saved');const saved=await p.evaluate(()=>window.__terriStress.sim.worldHash().toString());await p.evaluate(()=>{const s=window.__terriStress.sim;s.removeWindow(0,18,5);s.setFloor(4,4,0);s.flushCommands();});assert(await p.evaluate(()=>window.__terriStress.sim.worldHash().toString())!==saved,'unsaved edit');await p.locator('#load-game').click();await p.locator('#confirm-load-game').click();await p.waitForFunction(h=>window.__terriStress.sim.worldHash().toString()===h,saved);checks.push('actual Save and confirmed Load restore typed window, floors and exact hash');await p.locator('#options-close').click();await p.screenshot({path:'D:/VIBES/.worktrees/fe58/terrilives/docs/assets/review-evidence/architecture/final/publication-game-desktop.png'});progress='phone p.evaluate(()=>({width:innerWidth,documentWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth,choices:document.querySelectorAll('[data-window-model]').length,status:document.querySelector('#window-status').textContent}));assert(layout.documentWidth===390,'horizontal overflow');assert(layout.choices===9,'nine phone choices');await p.screenshot({path:'D:/VIBES/.worktrees/fe58/terrilives/docs/assets/review-evidence/architecture/final/publication-game-phone.png'});checks.push('N opens chooser; nine choices available at390px with
